newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore dlr basically strong -OUB chief.
newsitem.headline: Singapore dlr basically strong -OUB chief.

text.p: The Singapore dollar is intrinsically strong and not likely to see much more erosion against other currencies, Overseas Union Bank Ltd (OUB) president and chief executive officer Peter Seah said on Friday.

"I think the Singapore dollar is intrinsically a very strong currency," Seah said at a news conference on OUB results. He said he thought the "so-called weakening" of the Singapore unit recently was due mostly to the strength of the U.S. dollar.
"I personally don't expect to see much more erosion in the Singapore dollar versus other currencies," he said.
"The slight weakness of recent times has probably been very healthy for the manufacturing sector (in Singapore)," Seah added.
